## Project 1: Read the Bond Before Recommending It

**Scenario.** Compare two recent bonds from the same or similar issuers for a conservative-income mandate.

**Objectives.** Extract coupon, maturity, seniority, security, call, sinking-fund, and covenant terms; map them to cash flows and major risks; recommend the better fit.

**Sources.** Issuer prospectuses and annual reports from the [U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission's EDGAR filing system](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+, the Canadian securities filing system](https://www.sedarplus.ca/); bond terms and trades from the [Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Fixed Income Data](https://www.finra.org/finra-data/fixed-income). If live records are unavailable, use the documented [Lecture 1 fallback bond and issuer snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-1-bond-features.csv).

**Deliverables.** Term-sheet comparison, six-link feature-to-risk map, recommendation with two limitations, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Contract accuracy 25; cash-flow analysis 25; risk reasoning 25; recommendation and limitations 15; presentation and attribution 10.

## Project 2: Funding Choice for a Corporate Treasurer

**Scenario.** Choose among a fixed-rate bond, floating-rate note, and bank loan for medium-term funding.

**Objectives.** Compare cash-flow uncertainty, refinancing risk, covenants, seniority, and investor base; relate the choice to asset duration; define conditions that would change the recommendation.

**Sources.** A public issuer's annual report, debt footnote, and investor presentation; benchmark rates from [Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED)](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/categories/22) or the [Bank of Canada bond-yield series](https://www.bankofcanada.ca/rates/interest-rates/canadian-bonds/); debt terms from [EDGAR](https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/) or [SEDAR+](https://www.sedarplus.ca/). If those inputs cannot be assembled, use the documented [Lecture 1 fallback bond and issuer snapshot](fallback_data/lecture-1-bond-features.csv).

**Deliverables.** Funding-needs diagnosis, three-structure comparison, annual interest-cost scenarios, recommendation and triggers, and a 10–12 minute presentation.

**Rubric (100 points).** Issuer analysis 20; structure comparison 30; scenarios 20; recommendation 20; presentation and documentation 10.
